targets.title: Which cognitive abilities underlie computational thinking? Criterion validity of the computational thinking test.
targets.evidence_quote: First, we wanted to replicate the contribution of reasoning, spatial abilities and numerical abilities by assessing the same subskills as Román-González et al. (2017).
targets.outcome_quote: Concerning the replication part of our project, our results support the view that CT is underpinned by reasoning, as assessed by figural reasoning, and spatial abilities, as assessed by visualization. However, in contrast to the original study, we also found a significant association between CT and mental arithmetic.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Authors confirm reasoning and visualization but explicitly contrast the arithmetic association with the original null association.
